content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've encountered an issue when trying to connect my [product_name] module using a Lenovo laptop. At the interface window, I select Ethernet, but the list of network adapters does not appear, so I can't choose any adapter. I've checked and confirmed that my network adapter works correctly. I tried another Lenovo laptop and faced the same problem. Any thoughts on what might be wrong?
Does the network adapter name include any country-specific or special characters?
No, it's a Qualcomm Atheros type, which is quite standard.
Which operating system are you using? If it's Windows, did you install [product_name] as an administrator?
I'm using Windows 7 SP1 64-bit, and the user account has administrator rights. I removed and reinstalled the network driver software after encountering the issue, but this did not resolve it.
Did you perform a fresh installation from DVD or update an older version of [product_name]?
The [product_name] software works fine. I installed it on a desktop PC and there weren’t any problems.

analysis.insight_summary: A user experienced repeated difficulty with the Ethernet network adapter not appearing in the interface list of [product_name] software when trying to connect a [product_name] hardware module on Lenovo laptops using Windows 7 SP1 64-bit. The problem occurred on multiple Lenovo laptops, suggesting possible compatibility or driver issues between the [company_name] software and certain network hardware or devices.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [company_name] software to reliably detect and display available Ethernet network adapters on their Lenovo laptops, so they can easily configure and connect their [product_name] module.
